newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-AC MILAN SAID TO WANT BAYERN MUNICH 'KEEPER KAHN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AC MILAN SAID TO WANT BAYERN MUNICH 'KEEPER KAHN.

text.p: AC Milan, who recently attracted German international Christian Ziege to Italy, have their eyes on his Bayern Munich team mate and goalkeeper Oliver Kahn, according to German media reports.
Kahn, Germany's number two 'keeper, admitted on Tuesday that he had offers from Italy.
But the 27-year-old player, who has a contract in Munich until June 2000, added: "At the moment I'm not interested in all of that. Bayern is the only thing on my mind."
Euro 96 player Ziege is due to join Milan at the end of the season.
